summary: Temporary restricted area A near Croydon, from surface to 2,500 feet, applying to all aircraft including drones.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED (CROYDON) AREA A.
WI AREA BOUNDED BY: 512516.51N 0000837.00W - 
512445.37N 0000343.84W THEN CLOCKWISE ARC OF A CIRCLE RADIUS 2.5 NM 
CENTRED 512217.00N 0000417.00W TO 512153.50N 0000020.66W THEN
ANTI-CLOCKWISE ARC OF A CIRCLE RADIUS 2.5 NM CENTRED 
511951.00N 0000157.00E TO 512014.57N 0000159.15W THEN CLOCKWISE ARC 
OF A CIRCLE RADIUS 2.5 NM CENTRED 512217.00N 0000417.00W TO 
511949.48N 0000458.73W THEN STRAIGHT LINE TO 512047.39N 0001209.28W 
THEN ANTI-CLOCKWISE ARC OF A CIRCLE RADIUS 12 NM CENTRED 
512812.00N 0002713.00W TO 512516.51N 0000837.00W. APPLIES TO ALL 
ACFT INCLUDING ANY SMALL BALLOON, ANY KITE, ANY UAS AND ANY 
PARACHUTE INCLUDING A PARASCENDING PARACHUTE OR PARAMOTOR. 
DOES NOT APPLY TO ANY ACFT FLYING IN ACCORDANCE WITH EXCEPTIONS
STATED IN THE BRIEFING SHEET. A BRIEFING SHEET BFS 140/2026 WITH
CHARTS, REFERS. FURTHER DETAILS WWW.NATS.AERO/AIS. RESTRICTION OF 
FLYING REGULATIONS MADE UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF THE AIR NAV ORDER 2016.
AR-2026-10348/01.
